    PathUtils.hasInterleavedLabels(Node node)
    Detects whether grouping node's direct child edges by label (the transform every JSON-family writer -- JSON, YAML, TOML -- applies via PathUtils.groupEdges(java.lang.Object)) would change their relative order: true when two or more distinct labels are present and at least one label's occurrences are not all contiguous in the original edge order (omnist-spec format.interleaving-lost, Sec8.3.8).
